audit.whatIsWrong: Every row of the chart disagreed with its own explanation. Level 1 was 'Skill' although whys[0] says 'the level-1 melee window is genuinely his'; Level 2 was Renekton although whys[1] calls it a coin flip; and Levels 3 through two items were split Renekton/Skill although whys[2] to whys[6] say Kennen out-ranges him, holds the poke edge, owns 6, cashes first item and grows past a falloff bully.
audit.why: 54.76% over 378 games in Kennen's favour against a champion with no scaling: Renekton has exactly one stage, level 1, and the lane belongs to Kennen from level 3 on. The packet chart reads exactly that way.
audit.corrected: L1 Renekton, L2 Skill, L3 Kennen, Levels 4-5 Kennen, L6 Kennen, first item Kennen, 2+ items Kennen. All seven rows proposed as matched pairs.

audit.why: The spike map is already the strongest part of this page: Renekton at 1-2, Kennen at 3, 6 and first item. Dominus is 120/100/80 against Slicing Maelstrom's flat 120s, so he holds an ult edge in the mid game, which is why level 6 is a fight you take on your terms rather than on cooldown parity.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ruthless Predator is tracked everywhere but never given a cooldown, and the page never mentions that it is an auto-attack reset — so the advice tells you to react to the cast when the real tell is the wind-up.
audit.why: Renekton kit: W Ruthless Predator, 300 range, 16/14/12/10/8s, stun 0.75s or 1.5s empowered, carrying autoReset and shield-break flags; E Slice and Dice, 450 range, 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s; Q Cull the Meek, flat 7s, heals off damage dealt. The missingInteractions rule autoreset-burst-tell applies directly.
audit.corrected: The W window is 16s at rank 1 and opens on an auto reset — step back on the wind-up, and commit inside that window.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal appears only in the report block; the content layer says Cull the Meek heals the trade back without ever telling you to buy Grievous Wounds.
audit.why: Cull the Meek is a flat 7s AoE heal that directly refunds Kennen's chip poke, which is the whole trading pattern this page recommends.
audit.corrected: Oblivion Orb written into wants.you[2] alongside the W window.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[0] refers to a 'full Dice (Q-W-E) combo'. 'Dice' is half the name of Slice and Dice and is not an ability on its own.
audit.why: Renekton's E is Slice and Dice — a single ability with two casts, not a 'Dice' step in a combo.

edits.before: Q-poke from range wins every melee matchup early. Identify how Renekton contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: His stun and Cull the Meek's heal beat your one Q at level 1 — farm from 950 and take nothing that lets him reach you.

edits.before: His level-2 W on-hit is dangerous, but your second Q point plus an auto mark can answer a dash-in — it is a coin flip until you out-range him.
edits.after: His W is an auto reset, so the wind-up is the tell — a second Q point plus an auto mark answers a dash-in, and it stays a coin flip.

edits.before: Trade only when his empowered W (Ruthless Predator) is on cooldown, then E-out before Cull the Meek heals it back
edits.after: Trade only in his W window (16s at rank 1), and buy Oblivion Orb early — Cull the Meek heals your chip back

edits.before: Land a fury-empowered W stun and full Dice (Q-W-E) combo while you have no mark stun banked
edits.after: Land a fury-empowered W stun into Slice and Dice while you have no mark stun banked

notes: This is the largest chart correction in my slice — all seven rows were inverted against their own whys[] text and against a 54.76% winrate. phases[1].rating stays 5/10, which already fits the 'Skill' read, so that row is a side/win pair only. Also flagged, not edited: diff is 'TRICKY' at 7.5/10 difficulty on a lane the data and the corrected chart both say Kennen wins; see questionsForUser.
